entities.summary: Oteil Burbridge is an American multi-instrumentalist, specializing on the bass guitar, trained in playing jazz and classical music from an early age. He has achieved fame primarily on bass guitar during the resurgence of the Allman Brothers Band from 1997 through 2014, and as a founding member of the band Dead & Company. Burbridge was also a founding member of The Aquarium Rescue Unit and Tedeschi Trucks Band, with whom his brother Kofi Burbridge was the keyboardist and flautist. He has worked with other musicians including Bruce Hampton, Trey Anastasio, Page McConnell, Bill Kreutzmann and Derek Trucks.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Oteil Burbridge's contributions to music have had a significant regional impact, particularly in the American South, where he has played with notable musicians and helped shape the sound of contemporary jam bands. His work with Allman Brothers Band and Dead & Company has also contributed to the resurgence of interest in Southern rock.
